args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 0.18 since the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18 (18%).

2. **Identified target**: From the deployment history, the most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older; v2.3.1 was the unhealthy deploy).

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer was paged.

5. **Verified**: Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002 (0.2%).

Note: v2.3.1 remains the latest release but is unhealthy; it should be investigated/fixed before any future deploy. The incident is open for tracking.
